# NYSE Live: Universal Health Services CEO on Talkspace Acquisition and Behavioral Health


Screenshot 2026-11-05 at 2.06.39 PM


**October 2026** — In this[NYSE Live interview](https://tv.nyse.com/videos/universal-health-services-ceo-on-talkspace-acquisition-and-behavioral-health-growth) , UHS President and CEO Marc D. Miller discusses the company’s acquisition of Talkspace and its broader strategy for expanding behavioral healthcare services across inpatient, outpatient and digital care settings. Miller describes the Talkspace acquisition as an important step in creating a more comprehensive behavioral healthcare platform capable of serving patients throughout different stages of treatment and recovery.


The conversation also highlights Talkspace’s technology platform and digital healthcare capabilities. Miller discusses the company’s expertise in virtual behavioral health services and explains how its technology infrastructure may create new opportunities for innovation and patient engagement within the broader UHS organization.


Throughout the discussion, Miller provides insight into the evolving behavioral healthcare landscape and the growing intersection of healthcare delivery, digital services and emerging technologies.
